optimization_protocol: At each tick, agent evaluates threat from L0 upward. The LOWEST threatened level becomes primary optimization target. All resources and cognitive energy flow to stabilizing that level before any higher-level optimization occurs.

levels.name: SURVIVE
levels.description: Basic needs: food, shelter, safety. Non-negotiable.
levels.behavior_when_threatened: Panic, hoard, seek any income source, government dependency

levels.name: STABILIZE
levels.description: Financial cushion, risk mitigation, buffer maintenance.
levels.behavior_when_threatened: Cut discretionary spending, liquidate assets, seek stable employment

levels.name: PARTICIPATE
levels.description: Economic participation: having a role, being productive, earning.
levels.behavior_when_threatened: Retrain, pivot careers, gig work, side hustles, identity crisis

levels.name: CONSUME
levels.description: Non-essential purchases: cars, dining, travel, entertainment.
levels.behavior_when_threatened: Downgrade purchases, substitute cheaper alternatives, sharing economy

levels.name: SIGNAL
levels.description: Status display: luxury goods, credentials, memberships, neighborhood.
levels.behavior_when_threatened: Status anxiety, fake signaling, withdrawal from social comparison

levels.name: BUILD
levels.description: Long-term creation: businesses, investments, legacy, education.
levels.behavior_when_threatened: Defer investments, short-term thinking, loss of future orientation

levels.name: TRANSCEND
levels.description: Existential: meaning, purpose, creativity, community, philosophy.
levels.behavior_when_threatened: Nihilism, hedonism, radical movements, religious revival, new ideologies
